quests.instruction: SCAN AND FIND THE LEXICAL MEANING
quests.passage: [Abyss Sector 101-1] The deep-sea ecosystem is highly ephemeral, depending entirely on warm thermal vents that can abruptly turn off without any warning.

quests.instruction: SCAN AND FIND THE LEXICAL MEANING
